facts.value: If leadead.x38 is nonnull, calls it_802EAC8C on the item and ftCo_800C7800 on the saved fighter pointer. Clears x48, reloads x4C from attr->x1C, and snapshots facing before returning false early in states 7 and 12. Otherwise adds it_8027CBFC(gobj) to xC9C. A full-threshold exceedance or state 14 runs shared calls and a small camera quake, then randomly selects it_802EA334 or it_802EA2A0. Otherwise state 8 calls it_802E9494. Above the fractional threshold, it_802EA804(gobj, 15.0f) selects it_802E9738 when nonzero; failing that, x50 > 1 and a random guard may select it_802EA334 or it_802EA2A0. The remaining branch multiplies horizontal velocity by 1.5, increments x50, and calls it_802E93C8. The final else branch also calls it_802E93C8. That callee requests state 11 with ITEM_UNK_0x1, not state 10. Every return from this callback is false.
facts.rationale: Corrects the baseline's wrong ordinary-reaction destination while keeping unverified helper and gameplay meanings literal. Final-else wording preserves the strict greater-than guard's equality case.

evidence.why: Complete guarded dispatch, strict threshold comparisons and all-false return behavior.
Ordinary reaction callee explicitly requests state 0xB.
